clusters.headline: Jabalpur excise officer notified over liquor ban without chemical test
clusters.summary: Jabalpur assistant excise commissioner Sanjeev Kumar Dubey ordered a district-wide ban on the brand "Sagar Gold" on 6 September, calling the liquor toxic after spurious-liquor deaths in Sagar district, and has been asked to explain within 15 days why he acted without a chemical test. The parent case: 11 dead and 54 ill across three villages of Banda tehsil, Sagar, with a preliminary probe pointing to supply from Lalitpur in Uttar Pradesh, after which Chief Minister Mohan Yadav suspended five officers and attached a sixth to Gwalior.

clusters.headline: Bihar floods affect lakhs across 11 districts as Ganga rises
clusters.summary: Wire copy dated around 6 September put the number affected at over 19.57 lakh people across 330 gram panchayats in 11 districts — Patna, Bhojpur, Saran, Vaishali, Bhagalpur, Begusarai, Buxar, Samastipur, Munger, Katihar and Araria — with an alert as the Ganga rose at Patna; other outlets carried a lower figure of about 16.85 lakh. Rivers were above danger levels, with boats, relief teams and community kitchens deployed; claims of 36 lakh affected across 14 districts could not be verified.

clusters.headline: Himachal legalises regulated cannabis cultivation and cuts licence fees
clusters.summary: A Himachal Pradesh Department of Taxes and Excise notification legalises cannabis cultivation strictly for medical, scientific and industrial purposes, with recreational use, unauthorised home cultivation and unlicensed sale or trafficking remaining illegal; industrial hemp cultivators pay ₹2,000 per bigha annually, while medical and scientific licences were originally ₹3 lakh per bigha and ₹10 lakh per bigha for manufacturers cultivating their own. A recent revision cut the cultivation fee from ₹3 lakh to ₹1 lakh per bigha and halved the annual processing and manufacturing unit fee from ₹2 crore to ₹1 crore.
